title: Fill-in dialog: a host's refusal-named row carries no record, so its options read only the typed values
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Found by the dev of #37250 (PR #37264) and confirmed by the seat L1 on that PR (7158746595). This is the same family as #37250, outside that card's file surface.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 补填必填字段的弹窗里，有一类行是服务端拒绝保存时临时点名补上的字段。这些行拿不到这次改动后的记录。弹窗里只有这类行、没有其它字段时，这类行的下拉选项只按用户刚输入的值判断显示，不看记录本身。例如阶段菜单弹出的纯确认框。
- **影响：** 少见，需要服务端点名一个前端没预料到的字段。一旦出现，就会重演 #37250 的「暂无可选项」。
- **改法：** 三处宿主组装这类行时，带上同一份合并后的记录。不加新写法，不改规格。

## What (read at #37264's head `57e988ac224`)

Each host builds `refusalField` rows as `{ name, def }` with no `record`. All three share one fix shape: set `record` on the refusal row from the same merge the collector uses.

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx` (~L416)
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` (~L776)
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRequiredPrompt.tsx` (~L203)

Kanban passes no `refusalField`.

## Done when

- A refusal-named option row's `visibleWhen` reads the record the write would leave, also when no collected field is shown.
- There is one pin per host, red without the fix.

## Notes

- Size S.
- Out of scope: the timesheet add-row dialog (`ObjectTimesheet.tsx`). It renders `FieldEditWidget` with no `dependentValues`, but it is not a pending-change case and nothing reproduces it.
- **Blocked-by:** #37250 (PR #37264), which adds `RequiredWhenPromptField.record`.
